plan.english: Father Sky, hear our song. Giver of good things, we praise you. You hold up the great heavenly vault. You are great among the gods. With thunder you split the vault. The waters came forth from it. Mother Earth drank the water. You look upon the earth from above. You know the paths of the stars. The wolves are afraid of your thunder. Give us swift horses. Guard our cattle from the wolf. May our fame be imperishable. Sky, listen to our words.

Sky, father of the gods, we sing of you. We praise your famous name. You set the stars on the vault. You set the sun on its course. You gave light to the earth. Now the night is gone. Dawn, your daughter, has arrived. She brings us bright radiance. Guard our horses and sheep. May the wolf not seize them. Give us good fame. May we live in your light and see the sun.

Father Sky, you thunder from above. Your thunder is great and heavy. The earth trembles, and the sea trembles. The cattle are afraid in the fields. Your wind blows on the sea. The serpent was hiding the waters. You slew the serpent with thunder. You freed the waters for the earth. Now the waters go to the sea. Slayer of the serpent, we sing of you. Do not strike down our cattle. Protect our fields and horses. May your fame be great.

Bright Sky, you are the giver of good things. Your light fills the broad earth. Your stars shine in the night. Your sun walks on a long path. Who knows your mind? The gods do not know your mind. You alone know it, Sky. You set names for the gods. You placed seed in Mother Earth. From her the grain grew. Now we bring you butter. Receive the butter, and become joyful in your heart. Give us grain and cattle.

Sky, great shining father, listen! You who split the vault, you we praise. You who set the stars, you we sing. You who freed the waters, to you we pray. Your great fame has reached the gods. Look upon our cattle in the fields. May our cattle and sheep become strong. May our horses be swift. May the wolf not come to our fields. Sky, we give you this song. Hear it and receive it.

Dawn, shining daughter of Sky, grow bright! You who drove away the darkness, you we sing. Night, your sister, went away. You came with swift horses. You wear bright light. You walk on the paths of the sky. The eastern sky is red. The sheep wake up in the pasture. Dawn, bring us wealth. Do not hide your light from us. May you shine on our fields. Daughter of Sky, we praise you.

title: Dawn Who Lights Up the World

plan.english: Dawn, come to us with radiance. You light up the bright sky. You light up the broad earth. You light up the sea. Night gives up the sky. Father Sky gave you a famous name. He set you on the long paths. You come again, and the dogs wake up. The wolves go away from the fields. Shining Dawn, give us wealth. May we see your light again. Do not leave us, Dawn.

Dawn, daughter of Sky, we sing of you. Night is your sister. When you come with radiance, she leaves. She covers the earth with darkness. You light it up with splendor. Night follows you on the long path. You found the cattle in the darkness. You drove them out to the fields. Then the cattle became joyful. Lead our horses to the pasture. Guard them from the wolf. May your light not go away.

Dawn, you have come; the darkness is gone. You are the light of the gods. You shine on the waters. You shine on the fields. You shine on the paths. Shine for us, Dawn! When you flashed up, the gods became joyful. They sang a song to you. Now we sing it again. Daughter of Sky, receive our song. Give us offspring and cattle. May we be free from darkness. Shining one, we praise you.

Where are you, Dawn? The night is long for us. The sheep are afraid; the dogs are afraid. We are seeking your light. Now you have come forth in the eastern sky. You stretch your radiance over the earth. You split the darkness with your light. The sun came forth from it. Come to us again, Dawn. Do not go away from us. We sing you a song. Your fame, Dawn, is imperishable.

Bright Sun, listen to our song. Swift horses draw your wheel. You climb the heavenly vault. You see the earth and the sea. Who hides himself from you? The night hides itself from you. The gods built your wheel. They joined horses to it. They do not become tired. Sun, heat our fields. Ripen our grain. May we see you, and may our hearts become joyful.

Shining Sun, you go up in the eastern sky. You look at our works. You know our oaths. Whoever breaks an oath, you see him. Then you go down to the sea. Then the stars shine. The serpent seized you. The gods split the serpent. They freed you, and you came forth again. Now you shine for us. Sun, give us light and wealth. May we stand in your light.

title: The Seven Horses of the Sun

plan.english: Sun, bright wheel of Sky, come forth! Your seven swift horses carry you. You go through the sky. Your fire burns the darkness. The waters become warm. The grain ripens in the fields. The darkness was hiding you. Dawn found you. She led you out. Sun, we sing your famous name. Look upon us and our cattle. Do not hide yourself from us.

At night, Sun, you go under the earth. There the dead are lying. You light up their darkness. Then you come forth from the waters. You follow Dawn on her path. Your light has reached the fields. The sheep go out to the pasture. Your wheel turns in the sky. It does not break. Sun, do not burn our fields. May our grain be heavy. Give light to the dead.

Fire, giver of good things, we praise you. You are born from the waters. You carry our gifts to the gods. You lick the butter. Your bright fire burns. You hid yourself from the gods. The gods sought you in the waters. They found you and led you out. Bring the gods to us. May the gods sit down and drink the wine. Fire, guard our cattle at night. Do not burn us, bright Fire.

Bright Fire, wake up with the dawn. We give you butter. You eat it, and your fire becomes big. You heat the waters. You cook our grain. You light up the night. The wolf is afraid of you. He does not come to our sheep. The gods placed you on the earth. They gave you to us. Do not vanish from us. May your fire be unfailing. Fire, give us good things.

Fire, your might is great. You who split the darkness, you we praise. You guard the cattle in the night. You guard the sheep in the night. You guard the horses in the night. You guard us in the night. The wolf is afraid and goes away. The darkness seized the earth. You came forth with radiance and drove it away. Fire, protect us with your fire. May the wolf not seize our sheep. Fire, we bring you our words.

Fire, carrier of songs, listen to us. The praisers sing of you. Carry our song to Father Sky. Carry our butter to Dawn. Carry our grain to the Sun. May the gods be sated. You went to the gods. You brought their word to us. Your fire shines in the night. Give us imperishable fame. May our offspring live, and may our cattle grow. Fire, we praise your famous name.

Fire, the night has come. The waters have become cold. We place your fire on the earth. We give it fat. The fire grew large in the night. It lights up the darkness. It heats us. It cooks our grain. Fire, you live in it. The gods hid the fire in the stone. You split the stone. The fire came forth from it. Do not burn the grain. May your fire not die.

Waters, mothers, hear our song. You go down to the sea. You nourish the fields. You nourish the cattle. You nourish the grain. Whoever drinks you, he lives. The serpent was hiding you. A great god slew the serpent. He freed you from it. You came forth to the light. Waters, carry the stain away from us. Give us power. May your water become tasty for us.

Waters of Sky, come to us. You fall down from the heavenly vault. You fill the broad sea. You go into the earth. The roots drink you. The grain grows from them. You are good and bright. Sky split the vault with thunder. You came forth from it. You went to the sea. Waters, nourish our cattle. Do not dry up for us. May our fields drink you.

Seven Waters, sisters, listen to us. You go along to the sea. The sea receives you. Cattle and horses drink you. Fire is born from you. You are the mothers of Fire. The serpent swallowed you. The earth became thirsty. A god split the serpent. You came forth again to the light. Sisters, go to our fields. May our grain become full.

Who are you, bright ones? We are the Waters, the daughters of Sky. Where do you go? We go to the sea, our mother. What do you carry? We carry the stains away. What do you give? We give grain to the earth. Daughters of Sky, we praise you. Carry our stains away. Nourish our cattle and sheep. May you not dry up for us.

Broad Mother Earth, we sing of you. You carry the cattle and the horses. You carry the waters and the sea. You carry the roots and the seeds. Who created you? The gods created you. Earth, you are productive. Sky gave you seed. Grain grew from you. Mother, nourish our sheep. May our grain grow. When our spirit goes away, receive us.

title: Earth Who Stands Beneath the Sky

plan.english: Mother Earth, you stand beneath the sky. You do not tremble at the thunder. The cattle walk in your fields. Your grain nourishes us. We stand on your navel. There we light the fire. There we sing a song to the gods. The waters covered you. The gods lifted you up. You became broad and great. May you stand for us. Give us grain and good fame.

Earth, mother of the gods, we praise you. Father Sky is above, and you are below. He gives light; you give grain. Our fathers died, and you received them. Now they lie in your darkness. You hide them from the sun. You guard their sleep. Remember them, Earth. Give us wealth and offspring. May our cattle grow in your fields. May our name be famous. Broad one, we bring you gifts.

Mother Earth, your fields are broad. Your sheep give wool. We milk your cattle. We eat your grain. We drink your water. What do we give you? We give you songs and butter. Father Sky saw you. He came to love you. The gods are born from you. Mother, protect our offspring. May our offspring grow. Earth, hear our words.

Gods, givers of good things, come to us! Sit down on the earth and drink the wine. Become joyful in your hearts. Father Sky, come with your daughter Dawn. Fire, bring the Sun and the Waters. Mother Earth, listen to us. You gods slew the serpent with thunder. You freed the waters and the cattle. You set the sun in the sky. Now we sing your great fame. Gods, give us cattle and horses. Protect us from the wolf and the serpent. Gods, your fame is imperishable.

Gods of the bright sky, we praise you. Sky is your father. Earth is your mother. Dawn is your sister. Fire carries our gifts to you. The Sun sees our works. Darkness lay on the waters. You split it with light. Dawn came forth; the Sun stood up. Now the earth lives. Gods, do not give us up. Give us light and good things.

Which god shall we praise? Shall we praise Father Sky? Shall we praise Dawn, the daughter of Sky? Shall we praise the Sun and Fire? Let us praise the gods. They are the givers of good things. They gave us cattle and grain. They split the vault and freed the waters. They set names on the stars. Let us bring them butter. May they drink it, and may they become joyful. May they guard us and our horses. May they hear our song.

Fire, I bring you butter. I bring you grain. I bring you a song. Receive them, Fire. Carry them to the gods. I ask you for cattle. I ask for horses and sheep. I ask for offspring. Give them to me, Fire. Guard me at night. I am your praiser. May I see the dawn again.

title: A Herdsman's Prayer to Father Sky

plan.english: Father Sky, I pray to you. My cattle are missing. The wolf seized them. I seek them in the fields. I did not find them. You see them from above. Point out the path to me. Lead my cattle to me again. Strike down the wolf. I shall give you a bull. I shall sing your famous name. Hear me, Sky.

title: A Sacrificer's Morning Prayer to Dawn

plan.english: Dawn, I woke up in the darkness. I lit the fire for the gods. I prepared the butter. Now I sing of you. Come forth, shining daughter of Sky. Light up my fields. Bring light to my cattle. Drive the wolf away. Give me wealth and offspring. I give you this song. May I see you again. Do not leave me.

title: A Prayer to the Waters for Cleansing

plan.english: Waters, I have come to you. There is a stain on my heart. I broke an oath. The gods saw it. Now I am afraid of the gods. Waters, carry the stain away from me. Cover me with your water. I give you butter and grain. Receive them, good ones. May the gods not see my stain. May my heart be free. I shall praise you.

title: A Ploughman's Prayer to Mother Earth

plan.english: Mother Earth, I plough you. I give you seed. I give you butter. I give you a song. Receive them, Earth. Father Sky gives you water. May the grain come forth. May the ears of grain become full. May they not dry up. In exchange, give me grain. Nourish my cattle. May my offspring live.

title: A Prayer to the Sun Against a Sore

plan.english: Sun, there is a sore on my arm. It burns me at night. At night I am awake. You see my sore. Dry it with your light. May the sore vanish from my arm. The darkness seized you. Dawn freed you. Free my arm from the sore. I shall give you a white bull. I shall praise your name. Sun, listen to me.

title: A Warrior's Prayer to the Gods

plan.english: Gods, I am a warrior. I go to war. My horses are swift. Two horses carry my chariot. Protect me in the war. May I not die there. May I overcome the warriors. You overcame the serpent. Father Sky struck it down with thunder. Give me might. If I come back, I shall give you seven cattle. May my fame be imperishable.

title: A Traveller's Prayer to the Sun

plan.english: Sun, you know the long paths. I go on a long path. Go on ahead. Light up my path. Guard my steps. May I not go astray in the night. May the wolf not see me. May I reach my brother. My mother is praying to you. May I come back to her again. You do not go astray. Sun, I shall give you wine.

title: A Father's Prayer for His Newborn

plan.english: Gods, my offspring is born. His mother has become tired. I set a name on him. Hear his name, gods. Guard him in the night. May he grow and see the sun. May he drive swift horses. May his fame be great. Father Sky, protect him. Mother Earth, nourish him. Dawn, shine for him. Gods, I shall give you a sheep and grain.

title: A Son's Prayer to Fire for His Dead Father

plan.english: Fire, my father has died. He lies on the earth. His two hands have become cold. Do not burn him, Fire. Carry him to the gods. Lead him on the long path. You carried our fathers yonder. Now they live there. May he sit with the gods. May he see the sun again. May his name be famous. I give you butter, Fire.
